title: Cervical Artificial Disc Arthroplasty
jurisdiction: CMS Hospital Outpatient Prior Authorization (42 CFR § 419.80)
description: CMS prior authorization for cervical artificial disc arthroplasty (cervical TDR). Requires single-level or two-level cervical radiculopathy or myelopathy confirmed on MRI/CT, failure of at least 6 weeks of non-operative conservative therapy, and absence of severe facet joint arthrosis.

criteria.name: Symptomatic Cervical Radiculopathy or Myelopathy
criteria.description: Documented cervical radiculopathy (intractable arm pain, paresthesias, reflex changes) or mild cervical myelopathy matching MRI/CT nerve root or spinal cord compression.
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm neurologic deficit correlating with imaging
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Hospital Outpatient Department (OPD) services subject to prior authorization under 42 CFR § 419.80 - 419.89. Medicare requires documented medical necessity to establish that the service is functional/reconstructive rather than cosmetic.

criteria.name: Conservative Therapy Trial Failure (>= 6 Weeks)
criteria.description: Documented trial and failure of >= 6 weeks of conservative therapy including physical therapy, analgesics, or cervical traction.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Hospital Outpatient Department (OPD) services subject to prior authorization under 42 CFR § 419.80 - 419.89. Medicare requires documented medical necessity to establish that the service is functional/reconstructive rather than cosmetic.

criteria.name: Severe Facet Joint Spondylosis Exclusion
criteria.description: Severe cervical facet joint degeneration, autofusion, spinal instability, or segmental kyphosis at the target level.
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude contraindications to mobile disc arthroplasty
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Hospital Outpatient Department (OPD) services subject to prior authorization under 42 CFR § 419.80 - 419.89. Medicare requires documented medical necessity to establish that the service is functional/reconstructive rather than cosmetic.

cms_reference.notes: No active NCD or LCD exists in MCD (NCD 150.10 exists solely for Lumbar Artificial Disc). Previously cited NCD 311 was Nesiritide. Governed directly by OPD Prior Authorization under 42 CFR § 419.80.
cms_reference.authority: Hospital Outpatient Department (OPD) Prior Authorization (42 CFR § 419.80)
